text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — Acme Health (acct ACME-0021) hit a payment snag. Card on file declined this morning and the ACH microdeposits still show as "unverified". They have a Dedicated trial overage for March we need to clear.

billing-bot: payment failure alert for acct ACME-0021 — 1 card decline, ACH pending verification. Invoice INV-2026 created for $18,400.

Carlos Ramirez: I just pinged the customer at support@acmehealth.com — asked them to retry card via portal and offered wire if they prefer. Waiting for their reply.

Maya Patel: Thanks Carlos. If they want to wire, we need finance to approve accepting wire today to avoid suspension. Wire usually takes 1-2 business days so would prefer card.

Nora Li: Do we have a PO or tax docs on file? Sales (Sophie) mentioned they were doing a PO but not sure it's complete. If no PO we still can accept wire but need billing contact + tax ID.

Sophie Chen: They said PO is coming — procurement is out today, so unlikely before EOD. Customer offered to wire with invoice reference.

Ivan Gomez: Plan: 1) attempt a manual retry on the declined card once more (low risk). 2) If it fails, accept wire instructions and mark invoice as pending-wire. Approve waiver to avoid automatic suspend for 48h? @Maya can sign off?

Maya Patel: Approve 48h hold for ACME-0021. We'll accept wire if card retry fails. Please record the waiver and update the invoice terms.

Ivan Gomez: Roger. I'll attempt manual retry now and update. If retry fails, I'll send these wire instructions to the customer.

Ivan Gomez: ```
Bank: First City Bank
Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Routing (ABA): 021000021
Account #: 123456789
SWIFT: FCBUS33
Reference: INV-2026 / ACME-0021
Note: send an email confirmation to billing@redwood.com with remittance info
```

Carlos Ramirez: Customer responded — they can do wire today but asked for a sample remittance PDF. Can someone generate the PDF with the exact amount and invoice number?

Maya Patel: I'll generate a remittance PDF and include the waiver note. Putting it in /shared/finance/remittances/ACME-0021_INV-2026.pdf. Carlos, send that file and the wire instructions.

billing-bot: invoice INV-2026 status updated -> hold_until: 48h from 1799991234 (waiver applied by Maya Patel).

Ivan Gomez: Manual retry failed (card decline persists). Moving to wire flow — sending remittance + wire instructions to customer now.

Nora Li: Once funds are received, please update invoice status and record bank reference. I'll log the payment and close the case. Also add PO when it arrives.

Sophie Chen: Noted. Keep me posted if they request any service-level hold or prorate changes.

Maya Patel: Thanks team. Follow-up: if wire not initiated within 24h, we'll schedule a follow-up call to unblock procurement.

Carlos Ramirez: Sent email with remittance PDF + wire details. Customer acknowledged.
